copy.Proje danışmanlığı; teknik ekip ve süreç: We provide project consulting, technical team and process management, design and development, analysis, calculations and reporting, manufacturing consulting, R&D and product development services.
copy.Takt hakkında sık sorulan sorular: hizme: Frequently asked questions about Takt: services, production model, scope, location and process from idea to production.
copy.Mühendislik danışmanlığı, hizmet kapsamı: Brief answers about engineering consultancy, scope of services and our working model. For more information, you can check our about us page or contact us.
copy.Takt, makina imalatı ve sanayide çalışan: Takt is a consultancy that adds external engineering power to the technical teams of companies working in machinery manufacturing and industry. It offers project consultancy, design, analysis, production coordination and R&D/project support.
copy.Mühendislik danışmanlığı ne işe yarar?: What is the use of engineering consultancy?
copy.Mühendislik danışmanlığı, bir firmanın t: Engineering consulting enables a company to strengthen its technical decisions, design and processes with external expert support. It fills in the missing capacity without the cost of full-time staff.
copy.Tersine mühendislik, mevcut bir parça ve: Reverse engineering is the creation of a digital/manufacturable model of an existing part or product by measuring and analyzing it. It enables the reproduction of old or non-technical parts.
copy.Fason üretim, bir ürünün başka bir üreti: Contract manufacturing is the outsourcing of a product to another manufacturer. Takt matches the job with the right solution partner and coordinates the manufacturing process on your behalf.
copy.Takt time, üretimde talebi karşılamak iç: Takt time defines the rhythm/pace at which a product must be completed to meet demand in production. This is where our brand name comes from: keeping business flowing at the right tempo.
copy.Üretimi kendiniz mi yapıyorsunuz?: Do you do the production yourself?
copy.Üretimi geniş çözüm ortağı ağımızla yürü: We carry out production with our wide solution partner network; We match you with the right manufacturer and coordinate the process on your behalf.
copy.CNC, lazer kesim, 3D baskı gibi işler ya: Do you do work such as CNC, laser cutting, 3D printing?
copy.Evet. CNC işleme/torna, lazer kesim ve m: Yes. We cover CNC machining/turning, laser cutting and marking, 3D scanning/printing, welding, coating and painting with our solution partner network.
copy.Evet. Prototipleme ve prototipten seri ü: Yes. We provide consultancy on prototyping and transition from prototype to mass production.
copy.Uygun projeyi belirler, teknik dokümanla: We determine the appropriate project, prepare technical documents and reports, and manage the process from application to execution.
copy.Tek bir hizmet alabilir miyim?: Can I get just one service?
copy.Evet; hizmetler tek tek de, uçtan uca da: Yes; Services can be purchased individually or end-to-end.
copy.Fikrimi üretime nasıl taşıyorsunuz?: How do you take my idea to production?
copy.Tasarım, analiz, prototipleme ve seri ür: We manage the process from idea to product through the steps of design, analysis, prototyping and mass production.
copy.Merkezimiz İvedik OSB, Yenimahalle / Ank: Our headquarters is in İvedik OSB, Yenimahalle / Ankara. We mainly serve the Ankara industrial ecosystem; We also work remotely on a project basis.
copy.İhtiyacınızı kısaca iletin; ilk görüşmed: Briefly convey your need; At the first meeting, we clarify the scope and put the schedule and outputs in writing. The first meeting is not binding.
copy.Ücretlendirme projenin kapsamına ve süre: Pricing is determined by the scope and duration of the project; We will share the clear offer after discussing the scope.
